mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_metadata (doc_id, file_name, file_type, page_count, upload_time, equipment_type, status, source_type, credibility_weight, persist_to_knowledge_base, is_temporary, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{docId}, #{fileName}, #{fileType}, #{pageCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{uploadTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{equipmentType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status}, #{sourceType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{credibilityWeight,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{persistToKnowledgeBase,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{isTemporary,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updatedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.update: UPDATE document_metadata SET file_name = #{fileName}, file_type = #{fileType}, page_count = #{pageCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, upload_time = #{uploadTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, equipment_type = #{equipmentType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, status = #{status}, source_type = #{sourceType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, credibility_weight = #{credibilityWeight,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, persist_to_knowledge_base = #{persistToKnowledgeBase,jdbcType=INTEGER}, is_temporary = #{isTemporary,jdbcType=INTEGER}, expires_at = #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, updated_at = #{updatedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE doc_id = #{docId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT equipment_type FROM document_metadata WHERE equipment_type IS NOT NULL AND equipment_type != ''
